semantics.input_rule: Exact file bytes/path/hash plus bootstrap context are inputs.
semantics.parse_rule: JSON parsing precedes Contract Format structural interpretation.
semantics.unknown_rule: Malformed JSON produces parse error; no partial acceptance.
semantics.identity_rule: Parser does not synthesize missing identity.
semantics.extension_rule: Unknown extension preservation/rejection follows bootstrap profile.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.
